metadata.method: Actual normal Brave browser through cua_repl. This file transcribes selected visible input labels and output rows from that session. It is not represented as an export of the full DOM. Full tool snapshots are in the task conversation.
metadata.setup: Fictional adult born01/01/1980, single, no dependants/disability. All other supplied inputs fictional. Initial gross work30,000; Social Security3,000; ordinary employment other expense2,000. When changed later: gross work10,000 then6,000; same Social Security3,000. Bank interest10,000 then1,000. Personal pension contribution1,500, limited to300 when work net1,000. Non-employment general gain/public-aid income20,000 added for binding allocation controls.
qualifications: Credit inputs are algorithm probes; programme/medical/relocation facts are not claimed verified.
The initial Balearic aid input1,000 was isolated within pre-existing general BI25,000; that credit window did not itself add taxable income.
Aragon rental input1,000 was isolated from existing dummy general income; programme rental-income consistency warning was acknowledged. It is not a valid complete rental return example.
Galicia thalidomide control is an included-income algorithm probe; its specific employment-income allocation is expressly reserved.

Numeric existing-value fill initially restored the old formatted value. Only keyboard-replaced, visibly verified values were used. Validation dialogs were inspected and acknowledged; premature stale-state reads were discarded.
The2025 programme is algorithm evidence.2026 rates are recomputed from current primary scales, with Extremadura and Valencia differences expressly retained.

visible_input_transcriptions.balearic_emergency: Importe de la subvención y/o ayuda a integrar en la base imponible
visible_input_transcriptions.balearic_note: NOTA: Si la subvención o ayuda ha dado lugar a una ganancia patrimonial, debe reflejar su importe. Si la subvención o ayuda tiene la consideración de rendimiento de actividades económicas, indique la parte del rendimiento neto reducido que corresponde a la subvención, una vez minorado su importe en la parte proporcional de las reducciones que pudieran resultar aplicables (Vea la ayuda)
